column1: # Where Git Core decides otherwise than Gitolite 3.6.15 (tests/gitolite_oracle.pl,
# --mode deny-wins, Git Core's rule for the order of rules), each with its kind;
# the test fails on any other difference, and on a listed one no longer observed.
#   bare-literal-grant  a bare literal grant (RW refs/heads/main) is the exact ref
#                       in Git Core and a prefix in Gitolite: Git Core denies
#                       main-hotfix, main/x... Stricter, by design of the migration.
#   read-by-ref-grant   a ref grant alone (RW+ refs/heads/feature/) lets Gitolite
#                       read the repository (R any); Git Core does not. Stricter.
# Against Gitolite's own first-match rule, the order of rules adds differences,
# all stricter too: they are order.tsv's.
